payload.headline: Netflix bounces to 58.1, still below value; next add at 52.77

summary.thesis: A grade B business with rising margins and cash flow trades below its fair value on every method, but growth is slowing and the trend is still down.
summary.decision: Long-term: keep adding in small, staggered slices. Swing: no trade while price sits below falling averages and resistance.
summary.act_at: add below 58.77, next slice at 52.77, no buying above 63.7

payload.happening: Netflix closed at 58.1, up 2.41% on the day, but still in a downtrend below its 20-day (61.99), 50-day (66.96) and 200-day (79.82) averages, all falling. The only news was reported debate over the Netflix show 'The Altruists' and how it portrays FTX, which matters for buzz, not for the business. The next earnings report is due 2027-01-19.
payload.business: The business is still strong. Free cash flow (cash left after running and investing in the business) rose to 11.4B from 9.0B. Operating margin (profit from operations per dollar of sales) rose to 31.3% from 29.14%. The share count fell 3.35% in a year. What is at risk is growth and how long the margin lasts. Quarterly sales growth slowed to 11.85% from 16.19% two quarters ago. The filings note that a 31% margin sits at the top of its 5-year range (17–31%), and peaks like that usually fade. Analysts cut this quarter's EPS (earnings per share) estimate to 0.68 from 0.73, a 7.3% cut in 30 days. Debt (12.7B) is higher than cash (8.2B), but cash flow covers it easily. The reported show debate changes sentiment only. It does not touch demand, margins, cash or competition.

worth.text: At 58.1 the stock trades at 16.5 times trailing earnings and 15.4 times next year's. Its price-to-sales ratio is 4.8, against a peer median of 6.5, and sits at the 18th percentile of its own 5-year range. A cash-flow model (DCF: today's value of future cash) gives 37.53 bear, 63.7 base and 76.06 bull. The own-history price-to-sales method gives 58.94 low to 122.15 high. Today's price assumes free cash flow starts growing at about 12.4% a year. At 10% starting growth the value is 52.77. At 20% it is 78.72. The gap between methods comes from the growth assumption: the bear case starts from analysts' 5% EPS growth, while the base and bull cases use the recent 15% sales growth. Margin matters too. If operating margin fell to 23%, the value would be 58.77, slightly above today's price. At 15% margin it would drop to 38.82.
worth.key_assumption: Free cash flow starts growing at 10% to 20% a year, close to the 12.4% the price implies, and operating margin does not fall much below 23%.

bull: Free cash flow grew to 11.4B from 9.0B, and free cash flow is 22.87% of sales.
Price-to-sales of 4.8 sits at the 18th percentile of its own 5-year range and below the peer median of 6.5.
Share count fell 3.35% in a year, so each share owns more of the profits.
bear: Quarterly sales growth slowed to 11.85% from 16.19% two quarters ago.
Operating margin of 31.3% is at the top of its 5-year range; at 15% margin the value is only 38.82.
Analysts cut this quarter's EPS estimate 7.3% in 30 days, to 0.68 from 0.73.

levels.what: Value if operating margin falls to 23%. Small adds below it still carry a cushion even if margins fade.
Value if free cash flow grows 10% a year, the low end of the fair-value range. This is the last planned add before the report.
DCF base value. Above it the margin of safety is gone, so no buying there.

longterm.why: The price is below the DCF base of 63.7, the own-history low of 58.94 and the 58.77 margin-fade value. Estimates are still being cut and no support level is listed, so adds stay small and staggered.

swing.why: The trend is down, with lower highs and lower lows below every falling average. Resistance sits at 61.14–61.64 and 64.56–65.08, and no support level gives a place for a stop. No trade until a close above 65.08.

decision.timing: The 2027-01-19 report comes before the 2027-02-19 option expiry, and options price a move of about 18.1% by then, so adds stop at the 52.77 slice before the report and further buying waits for a report that keeps operating margin near 31.3%.

change_mind: The 2027-01-19 report shows operating margin falling toward 23% or below: the value drops to 58.77, near the price, and the add case weakens.
This quarter's revenue comes in below the 13.4B consensus while EPS estimates keep falling from 0.68: that would mean the slowdown is deepening, so adds stop.
A close above 65.08 clears both resistance zones and would reopen the swing setup.
payload.what_changed: Unchanged: still adding in small slices, because the close of 58.1 remains below the 58.77 value that already assumes operating margin falls to 23%.
payload.label: Research, not advice.
